title: 16706 - 16706/P0322/000802
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28) loose
Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28)
technicalNotes:
The Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28) is also used as a reference sensor for the Krank Devir Sensörü.
Kontrol edin:  the wiring to/from the sensor and engine control module to rule out harness and module damage due to engine oil or coolant from a failed sensor or tensioner. This is an example from a 2012 Tiguan with Coolant in the ECM which resulted in G28 DTCs in addition to intermittent stalling.
